Soup Pan Mee.note: Wheat and egg noodles; ikan bilis soup and fried ikan bilis = fish; soy sauce = soy + gluten. Pork bone soup and minced pork, so not halal. Stated not spicy. Add-ons are modifiers and not counted in the base.

Dry Chilli Pan Mee.note: Wheat and egg noodles, poached egg; dark soy = soy + gluten; ikan bilis = fish; chilli flakes fried with dried shrimp = crustaceans. Pork lard and minced pork. Stated spicy.

Ban Mian.note: Wheat and egg noodles; ikan bilis = fish; soy sauce / dark soy = soy + gluten. Pork bone soup, minced pork. Soup or dry is a free choice; both have the same allergens.

Yee Mee.note: Wheat and egg noodles; ikan bilis = fish; soy sauce = soy + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g). Pork bone stock, minced pork.

Mee Hoon Kueh.note: Wheat dough stated no egg; ikan bilis = fish; soy sauce = soy + gluten. Pork bone soup, minced pork.

Tom Yam Pan Mee.note: Wheat and egg noodles; shrimp paste and prawns = crustaceans; squid = molluscs; fish balls and fish sauce = fish; evaporated milk = milk. Chicken stock, stated no pork, no alcohol: halal from ingredients (v8 ruling 1). Stated spicy.

Curry Pan Mee.note: Wheat and egg noodles; dried shrimp in the curry paste = crustaceans; tofu puffs = soy. Coconut milk is not milk. Chicken, stated no pork: halal from ingredients. Stated spicy.

Vegetarian Pan Mee.note: Egg-free wheat noodles; soybean broth, tofu skin and light soy = soy + gluten. Merchant tag vegan. Stated not spicy.

Hakka Lui Cha.note: Roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, firm tofu = soy. Brown rice, no wheat. Preserved radish has no allergen. Merchant tag vegan. Stated not spicy.

Fried Wantan.note: Wheat and egg wrappers; prawn = crustaceans; sesame oil; mayonnaise = egg. Pork filling.

Fu Chuk Rolls.note: Beancurd skin = soy; prawns = crustaceans; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g). Minced pork.

Sui Kow.note: Wheat and egg wrappers; prawns = crustaceans; sesame oil. Pork. Wood ear is not an allergen. Soup or fried is a free choice.

Fish Ball Soup.note: Fish paste and ikan bilis soup = fish; tapioca starch, no wheat. No pork stated: halal from ingredients.

Pork Meatball Soup.note: Light soy sauce = soy + gluten. Pork. Sold out in extra.json.

Braised Egg.note: Egg; soy sauce = soy + gluten. Merchant tag vegetarian.

Blanched Choy Sum.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g), so not vegetarian.

Sweet Potato Leaves Belacan.note: Belacan = crustaceans, so not vegetarian. Stated spicy.

Kaya Butter Toast.note: White bread = gluten; kaya with egg; butter = milk. Coconut milk is not milk. Breakfast menu only.

Half-boiled Eggs.note: Eggs; light soy = soy + gluten. Breakfast menu only.

Breakfast Set.note: Kaya butter toast (gluten, egg, milk) + half-boiled eggs with soy (soy + gluten) + default hot kopi (condensed milk). Breakfast menu only.

Kopi.note: Condensed milk. The menu does not say the beans are butter-roasted, so milk comes from the condensed milk only.

Kopi O.note: Black coffee with sugar. No butter roast stated (rule o applies only where the menu says so).

Lime Juice.note: Calamansi and sugar syrup. The sour plum add-on is a modifier.

Barley.note: Pearl barley = gluten (EU cereal rule). 薏米水 is the local name; the English line says pearl barley and the gold follows it (as v7).

Herbal Jelly.note: Guilinggao is a herbal jelly (no gelatine). Honey on the side rules out vegan.
